name: Labuan Bajo (Komodo)
tagline: Komodo dragons, pink beaches and manta rays
summary: Labuan Bajo is a harbour town on Flores and the gateway to Komodo National Park. Take a boat to see wild Komodo dragons on Rinca or Komodo island, hike Padar Island for its three-bay view, swim on a pink-sand beach, and snorkel or dive with manta rays in some of the world's richest reefs.
seasonNote: April to October is dry; July and August are busiest; seas are rougher from December to March.
arrival: Flights from Bali take about 1 hour.
gettingAround: Day boats or liveaboards into the park; walk the town.
cashTip: Carry rupiah for boats and warungs; cards work in hotels. Tipping is appreciated.
foodTip: Grilled fish at the night market, Flores coffee and Indonesian classics.
